To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

flame-made nano-structures of ceria show superior reaction rates for the two-step carbon dioxide (CDS) thermochemical fuel production cycle, and the superior performance is attributed to the high surface area of the nano-structures, which is maintained after 10 cycles of the CDS cycle.
flame-made nano-structures ceria powders show significantly higher performance in solar thermochemical fuel synthesis than commercial micro-structured material.
the structural properties of ceria strongly influence the reaction rates of two-step carbon dioxide (CO2) splitting (CDS), driven by a reduction of methane partial oxidation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel materials for the solar thermochemical production of fuels.
the structural performance of ceria for solar thermochemical fuel (CO) production.
the structural performance of micro and nano-structured cerias for solar thermochemical fuel generation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
flame-made nano-structures are the best option to improve the performance of ceria in solar thermochemical fuel synthesis.
the flame-made ceria powder has the potential of being a promising candidate for solar thermochemical fuel applications.
the nano-structured flame-made ceria powder has higher reactivity than the micro-structure commercial ceria powder, and the higher reactivity is attributed to the higher specific surface area.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the structural performance of ceria is strongly dependent on its micro-structural features, and that the nano-structured flame-made ceria has the potential to outperform the micro-structured cerium oxide for high temperature solar thermochemistry.
flame-made nano-structures are the key to achieve the highest reaction rates, and the best cyclability is achieved by flame-made micro-structures with a small amount of nano-scale features.
the nano-structured flame-made ceria is the most promising material for solar thermochemical fuel synthesis.

the structural properties of ceria powders have significant impact on the performance of ceria in thermochemical fuel production, and that the nano-structured material is superior to micro-structured commercial powders.
